summary: A live line chart that shifts in a new Live revenue point every 800 ms over a 20-point window.
use: Real-time monitoring such as live revenue, traffic or latency streams.
spec: `let streamData = $state<number[]>` starts with 20 values from `68000` to `115000`
`setInterval` in `onMount` runs every `800` ms and sets `streamData = [...streamData.slice(1), next]`
